notes.signedUrls: The photo endpoint never mints a signed URL: every GET re-evaluates orbit_photo_access and streams the bytes itself, so there is no URL whose lifetime could outlive the close. The question is answered by construction, and the same GET that returned bytes before the close returns 404 after it.
